messages:
maya: Deployed batching/heuristic change to continuous-batcher v3 at 1951234567. Saw a perf win in 95th pct but started seeing QA failures on long-context evals for Mistral-8B.
kevin: Can you paste the eval diff?
maya: Short summary:
- latency p95 down 12%
- throughput +9%
- eval pass rate drop on long-context prompt set: 98% -> 87%
- hallucination rate up on persona prompts.
maya: paste logs:
```
EVAL> seed=42 model=mistral-8b runtime=continuous-batcher-v3 kernel=auto-selector
input_len=4k output_len=512 model_rope_scale=1.0 -> 0.99
quality: exact_match 0.78 -> 0.69
```
omar: interesting, `kernel=auto-selector` decided to swap to `tiling-attn-fast` for long sequences after the batching heuristics change.
lia: also noticing KV cache hit rate dropped from 0.94 -> 0.82 after v3. eviction_count spiked in profile.
kevin: do we have perf profile? 
maya: yes, attached snippet:
```
PROFILE: continuous-batcher-v3
- batch_size median: 12 -> 20
- scheduler: aggressive_fill=true
- kernel_selector: cost_model_weight=0.6 (was 0.4)
- kv_cache_evictions: 6.2/s -> 18.9/s
- kv_read_latency_p95: 1.2ms -> 3.5ms
```
kevin: kv eviction up explains context corruption -> hallucinations. Maybe the kernel swap has different kv layout expectations (head dim ordering?)
omar: checked diffs: `tiling-attn-fast` uses `head_interleave=true` path, whereas prior kernel `basic-attn` used `head_interleave=false`. That can break per-head kv indexing if `kv_layout` inferred from model config.
maya: which models hit it? Mistral + Mixtral appear sensitive; Qwen less so because it sets explicit `kv_layout` in model config.
runtime-bot: alert: rollback_candidate=true for continuous-batcher-v3 due to quality drop (>5% on eval). /cc @oncall
lia: proposed mitigation: disable kernel_selector auto-swap for models without explicit kv_layout; fallback to `basic-attn` and revert cost_model_weight.
kevin: quick patch rolling to canary with `kernel_selector.kv_layout_strict=true` and cost_model_weight=0.4. pushing now.
maya: canary results: p95 back up ~3% but eval pass recovered to 96% on canary cluster. kv evictions down to 7.1/s.
omar: long-term fix: add kernel contract validation on load (check head_count, head_dim, expected kv interleave flag) and unit test matmul indexing.
lia: also add an eval rim test that exercises 4k+ context persona prompts.
kevin: agree. after canary stabilizes we'll do full rollback or patch depending on SLA.
maya: thanks all. filing follow-up ticket: INF-8721 with logs and bisect. 
kevin: assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml for kernel contract fix.
maya: wrap up: rolling back continuous-batcher-v3 in prod in 5m unless canary holds :hourglass_flowing_sand:
